instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Listen in on a meeting or a room until a time I give, and keep each person's turn as it is said", and give it until (When to stop listening, as a time (for example 2026-10-31T15:30:00-06:00)); model_path (The ggml Whisper model file on this computer).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:listen-for-a-while and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Records the microphone on this computer until `until`, hears each short piece of it on this computer with the Whisper model the person names, names each turn from the voices people enrolled (tool:enrol-a-voice-or-face; unknown voices keep the same number for the whole listening), and writes one heard row per turn as soon as its piece has been heard: the listening, the device, when it began and ended, the words, who said it, whether it is the person, the voice and how sure the match was.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: heard (records:write); listening-voices (records:list, records:write); voice-print (records:list); recording-rule (records:list); recording-facts (records:read); listening-switch (records:read); transcriber (records:read, records:write); listening-status (records:write); undefined (write_file_start, write_file_piece, write_file_finish).
